Squad & combine

Buy team slots in the store, up to 15 units. Combine 3 of the same type and star tier into one stronger unit. Every deployed unit fights together. Select a unit for its stats and loadout; each unit has its own script and optional squad orders. Your collection is saved on this device.

★ Scan, Fire, Move · ★★ adds Cover and Dodge · ★★★ adds Precision aim and Retreat. Every run starts with one tank. Recruit units from random victory rewards.

Multiplayer arena

Invite matches run on the match server. Use the hosted game for internet invites, or the local bridge for USB tests. Both players submit their squad; the server controls combat and reports the result.

Online units and credits are server-owned. Practice saves/imports never enter online battles. Use the online armory to recruit and equip your online units.

Random attacks fight a real player's saved squad on this map. Defenders can be offline. Strength comes from deployed units and tiers.

Armory & cosmetics

Gear changes stats. Squad orders control coordination. Drag owned gear onto a slot, or tap Equip. Select units in Squad & combine.

Retirement & cosmetics

Unit transfer

Export your collection or paste a validated unit collection to import. Programs and equipment are included. Imported progression is for local play.

Quartermaster store

Earn credits by winning arena levels. Credits and purchased slots are saved on this device. No real-money purchases.

Extra team slot

Protected online armory & scripts

Practice store

Reserve recruits

When your team is full, recruits wait here. Buy a slot or combine units, then move them to the team.

Arena victory

Choose your permanent upgrade

Every victory gives one unit reward AND one permanent unit upgrade. Choose both to continue.

Field base construction

Buy structures between battles. Repairs and ammunition support nearby squad members; walls block shots and movement. Structures and upgrades remain across runs. Build areas are fixed on your side of the arena.

Unit stats

Stats reflect the selected unit and its equipment. Equipment, permanent upgrades and active script functions affect combat.

Project board tracks combat systems and future additions.

Paste Python unit & squad scripts

Copy the function documentation to any LLM you choose. Ask for plain Python def tick(unit, squad): code, then paste it here. No AI service runs inside this game.

Player leaderboard

Random-attack wins, then win/loss record. Campaign progress stays on your device.
